verdict.rationale: Featurebase's docs confirm hosted, brandable standalone pages and embeddable widgets (though evidence focuses on changelogs, e.g. featurebase-docs-8, featurebase-docs-9) and a JS SDK for the 'Featurebase Messenger' widget (featurebase-probe-1), which implies embedding/linking capability into a host product. However, no citation explicitly documents a feedback-portal link/widget mechanism for developers. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a feedback board URL/embed snippet, a 'add link to portal' guide, or SDK reference confirming feedback-portal (not just changelog) linking.
